items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Yeah, Tourmalon was with us. He was playing bass, wasn't he?

ctx.x: The bunch was in the picture, mostly. Yeah. So you all was there. Tourmalon played with him for a while, didn't he?

Yeah, Tourmalon was with us. He was playing bass, wasn't he? He was playing bass. Well, during that time, I was at the Matty Grind, and this is all the employees here, Joe Robichore. He was playing intermissions. Oh yeah.
